Furthermore, the data highlights a concentration of suppliers from Asia, which may indicate a reliance on a single region, increasing supply chain vulnerability to regional disruptions.

Conducting a thorough risk assessment of the top suppliers, focusing on lead time variability and on-time delivery rates, to identify potential vulnerabilities and develop targeted mitigation strategies. 2. Exploring diversification of the supplier base, particularly in regions with lower risk profiles, to enhance supply chain resilience and reduce reliance on a single region.

narrative.executive_summary: Our platform is currently facing operational risks stemming from inconsistent supplier lead times and inventory management issues, which pose a medium to high threat level. Specifically, we have detected medium severity threats in supplier lead time anomalies and reorder point breaches, while supplier risk assessment reveals a concerning trend of inconsistent lead times and on-time delivery rates across suppliers. Immediate action is required to mitigate these risks and prevent potential operational disruptions.
